lessons.title: HTML Structure
lessons.description: Basic HTML tags and document structure

questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML is the standard markup language for creating web pages

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to change text color?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property sets the color of text content

questions.question: What is the purpose of the <head> tag in HTML?
questions.answer: Contains metadata, title, links to stylesheets, and scripts
questions.explanation: The head section contains information about the document

questions.question: Which method is used to select an element by ID in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: getElementById() is the standard method to select elements by their ID attribute

questions.question: What is the CSS Box Model?
questions.answer: Content, padding, border, and margin layers that surround an element
questions.explanation: The box model describes how elements take up space on the page

questions.question: What does 'event.preventDefault()' do in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: preventDefault() stops the browser's default behavior for that event

questions.question: Explain the difference between 'let', 'const', and 'var' in JavaScript.
questions.answer: 'var' is function-scoped and hoisted, 'let' is block-scoped and can be reassigned, 'const' is block-scoped and cannot be reassigned
questions.explanation: Modern JavaScript prefers let and const over var for better scoping
